proposals.title: IExtendedMetadataStore Interface
proposals.rationale: Reported as a major defect: the IExtendedMetadataStore trait was defined in src/iextended_metadata_store.rs but the module was never declared or re-exported in src/lib.rs, so it was not part of the compiled crate. Per Phase B policy this defect was ALREADY FIXED on the main development thread. Verified in current source: src/lib.rs:77 declares `mod iextended_metadata_store;` (ungated) and src/lib.rs:99 has `pub use iextended_metadata_store::{ExtendedMetadataStoreError, IExtendedMetadataStore};` (ungated). The trait (put/get/delete/iterate_all/force_flush) is defined at src/iextended_metadata_store.rs:30 and is now exported. Spec FR-014 text already correctly describes the implemented trait, so no spec change is required.

proposals.title: Supporting Types - Extended Metadata Store (ExtendedMetadataStoreError)
proposals.rationale: Same orphaned-module root cause as FR-014: the 4-variant ExtendedMetadataStoreError enum (NotFound, StorageError, CapacityExhausted, ValueTooLarge) existed but was not exported because its module was undeclared. Per Phase B policy this was ALREADY FIXED on the main thread. Verified: the enum with exactly those 4 variants is defined at src/iextended_metadata_store.rs:5-15 and is re-exported by the ungated `pub use iextended_metadata_store::{ExtendedMetadataStoreError, IExtendedMetadataStore};` at src/lib.rs:99. Spec FR-025 text already matches the implementation, so no spec change is required.
